# S-003 · Sanctiemaatregelen

## What it says

- Exporting certain goods to certain countries is sometimes banned, or allowed only with a permit [W2-005].
- The page states the duty in general terms; it says nothing specific about how to screen buyers.

- [[sanctions-and-export-screening]]
